sentences.text: Maya Khabira Rudolph -LRB- born July 27 , 1972 -RRB- is an American actress , comedian , and singer .

After becoming a member of The Groundlings improv troupe in the late 1990s , Rudolph joined the NBC television series Saturday Night Live , on which she was a cast member from 2000 to 2007 .
